name: llm-benchmarks-viewer
description: A collection and visualization tool that aggregates results from many LLM benchmark suites to enable quick comparison of models, tasks, and metrics. It is designed to help researchers and practitioners explore performance trends across diverse tasks and configurations. The dataset/viewer focuses on metadata and reported scores rather than providing new evaluation data itself.
reputation: A useful community resource for browsing and comparing LLM benchmark results with modest adoption among researchers and practitioners.
